current_state.zh: Reth v2.7.0 ships Sepolia readiness for the Glamsterdam/Amsterdam hardfork — requiring Sepolia operators to upgrade before 6 October 2026 — along with persistent RocksDB storage for block access lists and fixes to state persistence, forkchoice, RPC, and networking.
